lightningAddress.title: Your Lightning Address
lightningAddress.body: Receive sats from any Lightning wallet in the world at an address as simple as yourname@qvpay.me. They land in your balance instantly.

receiveAnywhere.title: Share it like an email
receiveAnywhere.body: Copy it, share it or show the QR from Receive. Phoenix, Wallet of Satoshi, Blink, Alby… anyone can pay you, no QvaPay account needed.

satsOrUsd.title: In USD or in sats, you choose
satsOrUsd.body: Dollars at the current price, or sats as they come with no fee, to spend in the store or withdraw over Lightning.
